stellarLibrary: BC03 / Chabrier / Z=0.008, preserved Johnson BVR integrations
gasMeaning: Hydrogen recombination color prior. Metal lines and the photo passbands remain uncertain; only global component grades can adjust this.
law: Gordon 2003 LMC average Rv=3.41; B/V measured ratio, R-band optical proxy

gasColorCalibration.reason: Unknown publisher passbands and processing, and missing metal lines in the pure hydrogen prior. This is a single color grade per component, applied before classification.

dustProxy: Fixed dark-lane contrast and local red/blue excess along the Gordon reddening direction, weighted by available illumination, plus an unresolved floor. Bell normalizes one total column budget. Not a measured dust-depth map.

thicknessStatus.bar: Gaussian ellipsoid at the adopted published qz upper limit
thicknessStatus.young: Observed VMC/OGLE Cepheid sech-squared profile for diffuse light; finite width-based clouds for compact light
thicknessStatus.gas: Width-based compact volumes plus unchanged thin diffuse emission
thicknessStatus.dust: Unchanged intermediate Gaussian layer and Bell column budget

extension: 64-source-pixel smooth fade into the accepted old stellar paper profile. Young, gas and dust beyond the photo remain unsupported, as in l8. Non-converged or ambiguous warp projection branches revert smoothly to the paper profile. The boundary young/old ratio is a diagnostic only.

split.method: One fixed 3 by 3 spectral inverse per observed pixel, negative-cone clipping and algebraic total-light conservation. No local optimization.

geometry: The diffuse fields remain in the accepted Choi/Oden disc coordinates. Each compact source has a finite, shrinking three-dimensional cross section around its observed position and warped-plane centre. The bar is an analytic triaxial ellipsoid, not a repeated photo.
cloudDefinition: Deterministic watershed of compact photo emission. Each region has its measured on-sky RMS width, including finite pixel areas, as its line-of-sight RMS depth. Compact quartic cross sections shrink towards their 3D boundary. Region centres are on the accepted warped mid-plane. Flux is subtracted before replacement; no regional fitting.

cloudSegmentation.status: Fixed global image-segmentation choices, not measured individual memberships or fitted parameters. All native pixels within a complex retain their light.

youngDepth.source: Ripepi et al. 2022, section 7.1, equation 9 and Table 6; 4220 VMC/OGLE Cepheids. The reported sky-Z residual scale is converted to the disc normal. Observed ensemble spread includes distance errors and non-planar substructure; not an intrinsic height of newborn clusters.

barDepth.status: Kacharov 2024 section 5.2 gives only qz <= 0.35, not a measured best thickness. Adopt the upper allowed value as an explicit choice. Keep Rathore placement and Kacharov planar axes. OGLE 2016 finds no significant global vertical offset.
